cards.title: TikTok image sizes at a glance

groups.label: Full-screen vertical
groups.text: A 1080×1920 image fills a phone screen without black bars.

groups.label: Square images
groups.text: Square images can work on TikTok.

groups.label: Profile photo
groups.text: TikTok recommends at least 200×200 for profile pictures at the time of writing.

cards.name: how-to
cards.title: How to resize a photo for TikTok

steps.title: Choose the preset
steps.text: Pick video/photo, square or profile photo.

steps.title: Fill to crop, or fit to pad
steps.text: Most horizontal photos lose their sides when cropped to 9:16.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Export as JPG for photographs or PNG for graphics with text.
